ticket_text: I need all my data exported immediately, but I can't find the export button in the settings menu.

I'm having trouble logging in to the Northbeam app, and I can't access my team's data either. I reset my password last night and still get locked out after 5 attempts. I'm not sure if this is a login issue or if something went wrong with the sync. I thought it might be a technical issue since the export feature stopped working, but I can't even get in to check. Also, I'm not sure if this is affecting everyone or just me — I asked my colleague and they said they're not having trouble. The customer portal says my account is active, but I can't see anything in the dashboard. Is there any way to verify if this is a system-wide issue or just my personal access?
Our entire team is locked out — we can't access the app at all, and the login page times out after 5 seconds. This is happening right now and we need immediate help.

Some team members can't log in, but others can. I think it's a 503 error, but I'm not sure. One user said they changed their password and now they're locked out. Could this be a login issue or a system outage?

Our app crashed about 30 minutes ago and now no dashboards or reports are loading. All users are seeing a blank screen. We can't track progress or invoice clients. There's no error message in the logs. We're not sure if it's a login issue or a server problem. We're missing the last month's export data too, which is critical for our billing cycle.

The Northbeam platform has been completely unreachable for over 90 minutes. All users across our company are seeing a blank screen and no response to any login attempts. We've tried refreshing, checking our network, and restarting our local services, but nothing has resolved the issue. This is affecting the entire team's ability to access project data and complete urgent client deliverables. We are now unable to meet our deadlines and have been contacted by three key clients who need updates. We are concerned this may be a service-wide outage and not an isolated technical issue.

I can't log in to my Northbeam account anymore. I tried resetting my password through the forgot password link, but after clicking it, I'm stuck on a page that just says 'Invalid request'. I've already tried on two different devices and browsers. I'm worried it's a security issue because I didn't realize I had a password reset request sent to my email, and I didn't click it. I'm not sure if this is just a glitch or if someone else accessed my account. I don't have access to my old recovery email either, and I can't reset it without logging in first. It's affecting my entire team since we rely on this for daily reporting, and I don't know how to recover without help.

Our entire team can't access the app for over an hour. The login page is blank and we're seeing 503 errors everywhere. No one can log in or check dashboards. We're not sure if this is a billing or technical issue.

We're really struggling with the current export functionality. It's taking way too long to generate reports, especially for large datasets. We've tried adjusting settings, but nothing helps. Also, there's no option to export in CSV format — only in the default JSON, which our accounting team can't use. It would be a huge help if we could export data in CSV or Excel directly. This is making our month-end close extremely slow and error-prone. We're considering switching platforms if this isn't addressed soon. Could you please add support for CSV and Excel exports? We'd love to see it in the next update.

The app crashed during our weekly sync with QuickBooks and now the entire team can't access any reports. We've tried reloading, restarting, and switching browsers — nothing works. We need this fixed urgently because we're losing client trust and can't close the month-end audit.

We received an invoice for $2,500 for March, but we only have 10 active users and our plan caps at $1,500. This charge appears incorrect and was not reflected in our billing dashboard. We need clarification and a full refund if this is a mistake.

I need to export all my team's data from the past six months for compliance review. The export tool has been slow, but I can still access the data manually. I’ve been trying to initiate the export for over 48 hours and haven’t been successful, so I’m reaching out to request a full export via email or direct download.
The payment for our March subscription failed and we haven't received a confirmation email. Our plan is now in suspended status.

I would like to request a data export of all my team's project activity from the last six months, including task assignments, timelines, and completed work. I'm currently trying to audit our project performance for a quarterly review. The export link on the dashboard is missing, and I can't access it directly. Is there an alternative way to get this data, or can you initiate the export process for me?

I can't log in to my Northbeam account after trying to reset my password three times. The email with the reset link didn't arrive, and I'm not sure if it's a failed attempt or if my account was locked. I need immediate access to finalize our Q1 financial reports. I've tried the recovery options but can't get past the 2FA prompt without my phone, which is currently out of service.
The app has been crashing every time I open a project board, and I can't access any of the dashboards since 3 PM today.

Our team keeps getting charged for extra seats even though we've downgraded, and I wish there was a way to pause billing during audits. Also, could you add a feature to export data in JSON format? It would save so much time.

I can't seem to export my data from the dashboard, and I'm getting a 500 error when I try. I've already tried restarting the app and clearing cache, but nothing works. I need all my data from the last 18 months, and I'm worried it's not being stored correctly. I'm also not sure if I've been properly audited — can you confirm what data is stored and who has access? I have two teams that are using this, and I'm concerned we might have a compliance issue. If I can't get this data, I'll have to escalate to legal, and I'm not sure if this is a technical issue or a data access problem. I’ve been waiting for a response for over two weeks, and I’m not even sure if this is an outage or just a bug.

I need all my data exported immediately — customer records, project timelines, and all audit logs from January to June. This is urgent because we're preparing for a merger and need to verify data consistency across departments. If there's a delay, we may lose compliance with our privacy obligations. Can you provide the export now or within the next 2 hours?
Urgent: Our March invoice shows $1,200 for 10 users, but we only have 5 seats. This is a clear overcharge and we need a refund immediately.
The app is down for everyone on my team, we can't access any dashboards, but I can still log in to my personal account. I'm not sure if this is a data breach since I didn't see any unusual activity.

We need all customer data from the last quarter exported in CSV format. The data is critical for our audit with compliance officers, and we have a deadline tomorrow at 9 AM. Can you provide the full export with timestamps and access logs?
We received an invoice for $1,200 for March, but no usage occurred during that period. This appears to be an error in billing.

We need all customer data from the past 18 months immediately — specifically, user activity logs, export history, and subscription records. This is urgent because our compliance audit ends in 4 hours and we must provide full access to our legal team. Can you export this data and send it via secure link before we miss the deadline?

I can't log in to my account anymore, but I think I reset my password correctly last night. I'm not sure if it's a 2FA issue or if the app just crashed. I've tried every device and browser, and it's still not working. Also, I saw a notification that my workspace was suspended, which I didn't trigger. I'm really worried someone else might have accessed it. Should I just delete the account and start over?

Our team can't log in to the Northbeam app, and the login page is blank for everyone. I've tried resetting passwords and enabling 2FA, but it's not working. I'm concerned someone might have accessed our data from a foreign IP, but I can't confirm it. Also, I noticed that the export feature stopped working yesterday, which is making it hard to generate reports. We're worried about security and whether this is just a login issue or something more serious.
I need to export all customer data from the past six months for our compliance audit, and it's urgent as the deadline is tomorrow.

I'm unable to log in to my Northbeam account after resetting my password three times. I’ve lost my 2FA device and can't verify identity, so I need help resetting my 2FA and accessing my workspace urgently.

Our entire team is locked out of Northbeam right now — the login page just shows a blank screen and we get a 503 error on every attempt. This has been going on for over 60 minutes, and no one in the company can access dashboards or submit invoices. We’ve tried switching browsers, clearing cache, and even rebooting the network — nothing works. This is impacting our entire sales cycle, and we’re already behind on client deliveries. We can’t confirm if this is a single-user issue or a full service failure, but every employee across departments is affected. We’re panicking because our clients are calling us saying they can’t see our project timelines. Please confirm if this is a system outage and act immediately.

I need all my data exported immediately — we're running a compliance audit and have a deadline in 24 hours. This includes all project activity, user assignments, and financial records from the past year. If I don't get this done today, we risk violating our internal policy and facing penalties. Can you provide the full export right now? I've tried the button in the dashboard, but it says 'No data available' even though I know there's data. This is urgent and time-sensitive. Please confirm when the data will be ready and if there's any delay I should know about.

Our team can't generate invoices because the 'Invoice Export' button is broken and shows a blank page every time we try. We've been waiting for 48 hours for a response and need this fixed now to avoid missing client payments.
The Northbeam dashboard has been completely blank for over 60 minutes across all teams. No data loads, no login page, and no API responses. This is impacting our entire workflow.

We need the ability to export reports directly to PDF so we can send invoices to clients without having to manually convert files. This is urgent because our clients are already asking for PDFs and we're losing deals due to slow processing.

I can't log in to my account anymore, I tried resetting my password three times and it keeps failing, I'm not sure if it's a login issue or if my 2FA device is broken, I did see a message saying my account was locked after too many attempts, but then I also saw a notification that my billing subscription just expired and I'm not sure if that's related, I can't access any of my dashboards and I can't even see my team members' names, is this an outage or a password problem? I'm really stressed because I need to submit client invoices today and I can't even open the app, but I don't think anyone else on my team is affected, and I'm not sure if the issue is with my password or the service itself, I also found a note in my email from a week ago saying I should have upgraded to the Pro plan, so is that causing this? Can you please clarify what's going on and fix it as soon as possible?

We're currently using the Northbeam platform to track project timelines, but we've noticed that there's no option to set custom time ranges for filtering reports. This makes it difficult to analyze data for specific periods, especially during quarterly reviews. Could we please add a feature to define start and end dates for report filters? It would greatly improve our ability to generate relevant insights.

The payment for our March subscription failed again. We've tried using the same card and a different one, but both show declined. Our plan was set to auto-renew, and we're now worried about losing access to the platform. We’ve also noticed that the billing dashboard doesn’t show the latest charge attempt, which makes it hard to confirm if the payment was processed at all.

My account is locked out and I can't access it — I reset my password three times and still get 'invalid credentials'. I need immediate help because our team has been blocked from working for over 4 hours.

I can't log in to my account, I've tried resetting my password three times and it's still not working. I think I might have lost my 2FA device, but I'm not sure. I also noticed that today the dashboard started showing a message saying 'Service unavailable' — is that something you're seeing too? I'm worried someone accessed my account from a different country, especially since I didn't authorize it. I just want to confirm if this is a login issue or a broader outage. If it's a breach, I need to immediately lock down access and get a new 2FA method. I really don't know what's going on — it feels like both a password reset failure and a security threat at the same time.

Our invoice for March 2024 was charged incorrectly — we were billed $1,200 instead of the correct $800. We have proof from our finance team showing the original quote and agreed-upon pricing. This charge was not reflected in our plan upgrade, and we haven't received any communication about the discrepancy. We need this corrected immediately as it affects our financial records and client trust. We're also concerned that this might be a pattern, given similar errors in January and February. Can you please verify the billing logs and issue a refund or adjustment? We can provide further documentation if needed.

We’ve been using Northbeam for a year and would love to see a new report that shows real-time project burn-downs with sprint tracking. It would help us manage deadlines better. I know this isn’t urgent, but it’s something we’re missing. Can you please add this to your roadmap?

I'm completely locked out of my account and can't log in even after resetting my password three times. I thought it was just a temporary 2FA issue, but now the app says 'invalid credentials' every time. I've tried using my old phone and a different device, but nothing works. I also saw an email from support saying my account was suspended for suspicious activity, but I didn't do anything wrong. I'm worried someone else might have accessed it. I've been trying to reach my manager to get them to reset it, but they're not responding either. Is it possible this is a security breach? I can't even access my billing page to confirm the charges, and I'm starting to think our whole team is affected. But I'm not sure if this is a team outage or just my own account.

All users can't log in to Northbeam, the login page is blank and we're seeing 503 errors across all devices. No one can access the app or their data, and we don't know which user's credentials are affected.

I need to reset my password because I can't log in, but I also think there might be a billing issue with my plan — it's showing as suspended and I'm not sure if that's related to the login problem. I'm worried someone might have accessed my account from a new device, and I'm not sure if that's a security breach or just a login issue.

I need all my data exported immediately — customer has been blocked from accessing their invoices due to a system error, and we’re running out of time. Please export every piece of data from my account, including user activity logs and all financial records. This is urgent because the client demands proof of compliance and we can’t meet their deadline without it.

All 12 users in our department are unable to access the Northbeam platform. The login page is returning a 503 error on all devices. We've confirmed no internet connectivity issues and no individual account problems. This is happening across all workstations and mobile devices simultaneously.

We received an invoice for $1,200 for March, but we had already paid $1,000 in March and our plan was downgraded to 10 seats two weeks ago. The original invoice was for $800, and we believe this is a duplicate charge. We need to dispute this and request a refund before the billing cycle ends, as it affects our cash flow and team productivity.

The app keeps crashing when I try to open the dashboard, and it's happening to me and two other team members. We're unable to view any reports or track projects, which is blocking our client billing. I did see a notification about a 500 error in the logs, but I don't know if it's related to our team or just a one-off. I also tried resetting my password and logging in from a different device, and that didn't help. The dashboard used to work fine last week, so it feels like a new issue. I'm not sure if this is a whole-team outage or just an issue on my end. I'm worried we might lose access to critical data, but I can't confirm if anyone else is affected. Also, I just noticed that the export button is missing in the menu—does that count as a separate issue?
The payment for our team's plan expired and the app now says 'workspace suspended'. We need to reactivate it.
We need a new feature to sync our calendar directly with Google Calendar — it's urgent because our client meetings are scheduled there and we can't confirm availability without syncing.

The app has been down for over an hour now, and no one on our team can access it. I tried resetting my password, but the login screen just keeps loading. I also noticed that our invoice system is showing a failed payment, but I'm not sure if that's related to the outage. I've been unable to generate reports or check customer data, and we're worried about missing billing deadlines. However, I did receive a refund notice today, which might mean the billing issue is already resolved.

The app crashes every time I try to open the dashboard — it just freezes and restarts. I’ve been trying to generate a client report for the last two hours and can’t even get past the loading screen. This is blocking my entire workflow and I can’t submit invoices or meet with clients today. I’ve already sent a message to support and they said it’s not an outage, but I’m not sure what else to do.

I can't access my invoice portal because the payment for last month failed again. I've tried using a different card and a different payment method, but both show 'failed'. The dashboard says the workspace is active, but I can't view or download any invoices. This is the third time this month, and I've already sent a refund request. I'm worried we'll lose clients if we can't issue invoices on time. Can you please check the billing status and fix it immediately?

Our team can't log in right now, the login page is completely blank — this is affecting everyone. I've checked the status page and it says everything is up. Also, I really wish we could export reports directly to Excel instead of having to use the CSV option and manually fix formatting. That process takes too long and we're losing time on client meetings. If we can't fix the login issue, we might have to switch platforms entirely. I know it's not urgent, but we're already behind on deadlines and need this feature ASAP.

The app crashed during our weekly sync with Salesforce and now the board is frozen. Every team member can't see updates, and the dashboard shows a blank screen. We've tried refreshing, restarting, and clearing cache — nothing works. We're losing critical client deadlines and can't even generate reports. This has been going on for 4 hours now, and we're on the verge of missing a major contract deadline.

I received an invoice for March that includes 10 extra seats I didn't subscribe to. I believe this is a mistake. I also can't access my dashboard because it's loading slowly, but I don't think it's broken.

We need a new feature to allow team members to export project timelines directly into Excel via a dedicated button in the project dashboard. Currently, we have to manually copy and paste, which takes hours each week and leads to errors. This has become a major bottleneck in our reporting process, especially during client audits. We’ve already discussed this with our manager, and it’s clear that automation is critical. Can you please implement this functionality as soon as possible? We’re under a tight deadline to deliver quarterly reports to our board, and without this, we risk missing key deadlines. We’re also open to alternative export formats if Excel is not feasible, but the ability to export timelines is the priority.

I've tried resetting my password three times through the app and email, but I'm still locked out. I don't have access to my 2FA device, and I can't log in to view any of my projects. I'm concerned this might be a security issue since I didn't initiate the reset and I haven't seen any login activity from my usual device.

Our team needs a new report that shows project budget vs. actual spend by department. It's urgent because we're preparing for the quarterly review and without this, we can't present accurate financials. I've tried the current dashboard, but it doesn't break down by department. Also, I noticed that the export function is broken and exports are missing data—can you fix that? I don't have access to the admin panel, so I can't reconfigure anything. I've been trying to reset my 2FA device, but it keeps failing. Please help me get this report and fix the export. We're already behind schedule, and this is critical.

Payment for our March subscription failed again. The card was declined and the workspace is now showing as suspended. We can't access any features and can't invoice clients. We're not sure if this is a one-time error or a recurring issue. No confirmation from support on when it will be resolved.

Our invoice for March 2024 shows an incorrect amount — we were charged $1,200 instead of $800. We’ve double-checked our plan and seat count, and the pricing seems to be off. We need a refund and a corrected invoice by end of day today, or we may have to escalate to our legal team.

I've been trying to request a new feature where the app automatically syncs with Google Calendar, so we can avoid manual entries. I'm not sure if this is already possible, and I'm also concerned that our current billing may be affected if we have to switch workflows. Also, I noticed the export function sometimes fails, but we can work around it by saving manually. I just wanted to know if this feature would be considered urgent or if it's just a suggestion.

We need a new feature to allow bulk export of reports in CSV format so we can share them with clients without having to manually export each one. The current export only allows single-file downloads, and it's taking too long to process 50+ reports. Can we add this functionality to the platform?

I can't get the new report dashboard to work, it keeps crashing every time I open it, and I'm also wondering if there's a way to export data directly to Excel instead of CSV — that's been a pain for months. I've tried resetting the cache, but nothing helps. Also, I'm worried about security because I saw a notification about someone accessing the app from a different country, and I'm not sure if that's linked to the dashboard bug. If this dashboard is broken, I can't bill clients or track progress, so it's blocking my entire team. But I really want a new feature — a built-in dark mode — because the screen is so bright and it's hard to use at night. Can you fix the dashboard and add dark mode? I'm really frustrated with how long this has been going on, and I can't even see the reports clearly without crashing.

We need a feature to allow bulk importing of team members directly from Google Workspace. It would save hours every week during onboarding. This is urgent because our new hires are currently having to manually add each person, which is slow and error-prone. Can you please add this to your roadmap? We’re going live next month and this would make the transition seamless.
I'm trying to export data to Excel, but it's not showing up in the dropdown. Also, I'd love to see a new report that shows team member productivity. Is this something you can fix soon?

I've been using Northbeam for a few months now and I noticed that there's no option to set custom labels on tasks or boards. This makes it hard to organize projects by department or phase. For example, I'd like to tag tasks as 'High Priority' or 'Client Review' so I can filter them quickly. It would also help with reporting, especially when sharing updates with stakeholders. I don't see any similar feature in the current UI. Would it be possible to add this functionality in a future update?

The payment for our October subscription failed again. We've already tried using a different card and verified the billing address, but the system still shows 'pending' with no update. Our team is blocked from accessing the app since the workspace is now in suspended status. We're not sure if this is a one-time issue or if it's recurring.

We need a way to export data in CSV format with column filtering options—right now we can only download raw data, which takes hours to process and wastes our team's time. Can we get this in the next update?

I'm really frustrated because the app keeps crashing when I try to open the project dashboard, and I can't even access the reports. I've already tried restarting, clearing cache, and switching browsers. But it's not just me — three other team members reported the same issue. I think we're missing a critical feature though: a built-in export option for the full project timeline. That would save hours every week. Why can't we just add a simple button to export the timeline in CSV? I'm begging you to fix the crashes first, but also add that export feature — it's so important for our workflow.

I’ve been using Northbeam for a few months now and I’m really hoping you can add support for custom automation rules. Right now, we can only set up basic workflows, and our marketing team needs to create dynamic rules based on user activity, like automatically tagging leads after certain actions. This would make our reporting and follow-up much more efficient. We’ve tried reaching out to your support team before, but there’s no option for conditional triggers or variable inputs in the current setup. It’s not urgent, but it’s something we’ve been meaning to ask for since we started. Could you please let us know if this is something you’re planning to implement in the next update?

I'd really like to see a new feature where I can set up automated reminders for overdue tasks in the project board. Right now, I have to manually check and remind team members, which takes up too much time. This would save us hours each week. I've tried looking through the help center and the product documentation, but nothing mentions this option. It would be especially useful for deadlines and recurring milestones. I'm not sure if this is already possible, but I haven't seen it in the current setup. Can you please add this as a feature? I'd appreciate a response as soon as possible because it's impacting our workflow significantly.
We need a new report that shows project timelines across teams, similar to the one in your competitor's product.

We're currently using the project tracking tool for our marketing team, but there's no way to generate custom report templates. It would be very helpful if we could save and reuse report layouts so we don’t have to rebuild them every time.

I can't seem to pay my monthly fee, and the payment page keeps showing error 404 after I entered my card details. I've tried three different cards, and none of them go through. The workspace is still active, but I'm getting a notice that my payment is failing and it might suspend soon. I don't know what to do — I'm not sure if it's a problem with my card or with your system. I’ve already contacted support before, but no one responded. Can you please confirm if this is a billing issue and if there's a way to fix it immediately? I need to keep the workspace running so I can continue invoicing clients.

I need a feature where I can schedule recurring reports to auto-send to stakeholders every Friday at 9 AM. Right now, I have to manually generate and email them, and it's taking way too long. This is urgent because our quarterly reviews are due next week and we're missing key data points. Without this, our leadership won't be able to make decisions on time.

I’ve been using the platform for several months and I’d like to request a new feature that allows me to set custom automation rules for recurring reports. Right now, I have to manually export and reformat these reports every week, which is very time-consuming. This would save a lot of time and reduce errors. I realize this isn’t a bug or a data access need, but it would greatly improve our workflow. I’m not sure if this is already possible, so I’d appreciate clarification if it exists. I’ve been waiting a few weeks to hear back about this possibility, and I feel it’s been overlooked.
We need a new dashboard view that shows real-time project progress with milestone tracking — it's critical for our quarterly reviews and client reporting.
I'd love to see a new report that shows project revenue by department — it's not currently possible to filter by department in the financial reports.
Could we add a feature to allow exporting team activity reports directly to Google Sheets? It would save a lot of time during monthly reviews.
We received an invoice for $1,200 for March, but we only have 5 seats and were on a $600 plan. This appears to be a billing error.

We need a new report type that shows real-time project spend tracking — it's critical for our finance team to track budgets as we go. Right now, we can only see monthly summaries, and we're at risk of overrunning our quarterly budgets. This feature is essential, and we're worried about missing key cost alerts. Can you add this ASAP? We're on the verge of a financial review next week and have no way to monitor actual spend in real time.

Our invoice for March was marked as paid, but we received no actual payment. We have double-checked the transaction and believe this is an error. We need a refund and clarification on how this will be resolved moving forward.

I'd like to request a new feature that allows exporting reports in PDF format, which would make sharing with clients easier. I'm also concerned that the current export to CSV is slow and sometimes corrupts data, which affects our ability to generate accurate reports. We've had a few issues with the export functionality lately, so I'm not sure if it's a bug or just a feature gap. If possible, could we get a fix for the corrupted files as well?

I need a feature to automatically sync our calendar events with the Northbeam dashboard so we can track team availability in real time. The current manual process takes too long and leads to scheduling errors. Can we add this integration quickly? We're already using Google Calendar and it's critical for our planning.

I can't get my team to log in at all — the app is just blank and loading forever. It's been happening for two days now, and I'm worried it's a security breach because I saw a strange IP address from Germany accessing my dashboard. Also, I'd really like to see a new feature where we can schedule recurring reports automatically — that would save us so much time. I think it's urgent because we're missing client deadlines, but I'm not sure if this is just a login issue or a bigger problem. I don't know if the login outage is affecting everyone or just me. Is there a way to reset the access for my team? Can we get a recurring report schedule like in the old version? If not, can we at least get a security audit? I've tried the password reset, but nothing works.

We're seeing a 30% drop in conversion on our Slack integration, and it's been happening for two days now. Could you please add a setting to enable fallback messaging when the Slack connection fails? We need this urgently to maintain client trust and avoid missed communications.
I need the ability to export reports in PDF format, but right now it only works in CSV. Also, the export function is slow and sometimes crashes when I try to generate large reports.

I’ve been using the Northbeam platform for a few months and I noticed that there's no option to set custom alert thresholds for project timelines. Right now, we can only use the default thresholds, which don’t reflect our team's workflow. For instance, if a task goes past 10 days, we’re not notified automatically, and this often leads to missed deadlines. I think it would be really helpful if we could define our own rules for when alerts should trigger—like based on task progress, team workload, or critical milestones. This would allow us to stay proactive about project management and improve visibility. It’s not a bug, and it doesn’t affect any current functionality, just a missing feature that could enhance our experience.

The payment for our March subscription failed again. We've already tried using a different card and verified the billing details, but the system still shows a failure. Our workspace remains active, and we're able to access the app, but we're concerned about whether this will continue and if it might lead to suspension. We need to know if there's a way to resolve this without losing our seats or being charged again.

We need a way to export reports directly to Excel or Google Sheets—right now we have to manually copy-paste and it's taking way too long. This is urgent because our clients are asking for weekly reports by tomorrow.

I'm really frustrated because the app is super slow when I try to create new tasks, and it just crashes when I open the calendar. Also, I keep getting error messages about data sync, and it's making it impossible to track projects. But honestly, I would love to see a better timeline view with drag-and-drop functionality — it would save so much time. I mean, the current one is a mess and I can't even get anything done. Is there any way you could add that feature? It's been on my mind for months now, and I think it's a must-have.

We're really missing a way to export project timelines directly into Excel. Right now, we have to manually copy and paste, which takes hours every week. This is slowing down our reporting process and making it hard to share with stakeholders. We'd love to see a built-in export option for Gantt charts or milestone views. It's not urgent, but it would save us a ton of time and reduce errors. Also, the current export only shows basic data — no actual timeline dates or dependencies. This makes our reports look messy and inaccurate. We're considering switching to a different tool if this doesn’t get addressed. Could you please add this feature? We're already on the most recent version, so it's not a bug or an existing limitation.

I'm reaching out to request a new feature that would allow us to set custom workflows for project milestones. Currently, we have to manually track and adjust deadlines, which takes up a lot of time.
